The test contains multiple assertions checking length, non-null count and ordering (via assertNonDecreasingIfComparable), verifying multiple properties rather than a single superficial assertion.
No @Ignore/@Disabled annotations or commented-out @Test methods are present in the provided snippet. Tests appear active and runnable.
The class Javadoc explicitly contains 'Requirement traceability: SORT-REQ-001', providing a clear link to a requirement.

practices_evaluation.practice_title: Rigorous Use of Performance and Security Tests
practices_evaluation.justification: The test includes an explicit timeout on @Test(timeout = 4000), which is an explicit performance-related setting; per decision rules this counts as an explicit performance test.
The method name 'test5' is generic and does not describe scenario or expected result; naming does not follow a descriptive convention like methodName_scenario_expectedResult.

practices_evaluation.practice_title: Small Footprint of Test Code Generation
practices_evaluation.justification: Signs of heavy code-generation tooling are present (EvoSuite imports, evo-specific imports like org.evosuite.runtime.*, and auto-generated test name 'test5' are visible), indicating likely auto-generated artifacts.

practices_evaluation.practice_title: Complete Prioritization of Test Case Design
practices_evaluation.justification: The test uses Given-When-Then comments and the class-level comment indicates a considered design intent; this indicates thought-through test design and BDD-like structure.

practices_evaluation.practice_title: Responsible Addition of Test Code Maintenance
practices_evaluation.justification: The test interacts with the public API (Ordenacao.selecao) and does not show any reflection or access to private internals; it verifies observable behavior.
There are multiple specific assertions and at least two of them include descriptive messages; >50% of assertions include messages, meeting the decision rule.
The test contains concise Given-When-Then comments that explain intent rather than obvious code, and no commented-out code is present.
No sources of non-determinism (no Random, no current time usage, no Thread.sleep) are visible; the test uses deterministic inputs and local state.

practices_evaluation.practice_title: Complete Avoidance of Test Side Effects
practices_evaluation.justification: The test uses only local variables and does not persist data or modify global/static state; no cleanup is required in this snippet.

practices_evaluation.practice_title: Suitable Utilization of Test Labels and Categories
practices_evaluation.justification: The class is annotated with @Category({SortingTest.class, UnitTest.class}), providing meaningful categorization for selective execution.
